page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred lines throughout; a manuscript-style ownership inscription at the top, a printed stamp/oval device at the foot (not transcribed as text).

main_text.l: Autore Clarissimo viro Thoma Erasto D. Medico.
Opus nunc recens ex ipsius Autoris authographo
lae, partim ad ipsum Autorem scriptae, partim ad
alios, quibus suum rogati, de hac re iudicium

page.notes: Ornamental printer's device at the foot of the page not transcribed. The ownership inscription at the top is handwritten/stamped and is included as printed. The imprint date line is printed as "ꞔCIↄ. Iↄ. LXXXIX." in the original; rendered here in Roman numerals as MDLXXXIX. The place name "PESCLAVII" is printed in spaced small capitals and is transcribed as printed; "Baocium" and "Sultaceterum" are as printed and may be misprints.
